김첨지: Kim Cheomji, a poor Korean rickshaw puller in 1920s Seoul, man in his early 40s, gaunt weathered sun-tanned face, sunken cheeks, short scruffy black stubble beard, short cropped black hair, thin wiry build, faded grey-white cotton jeogori jacket with rolled sleeves and loose baggy grey cotton trousers tied at the ankles, worn straw sandals
아내: Kim Cheomji's sick wife, a poor Korean woman in her late 30s in 1920s Seoul, very thin and pale, hollow cheeks, tired eyes, black hair pulled back in a low bun with a plain wooden pin, faded white cotton jeogori and long dark grey skirt (chima), barefoot in white cotton socks
치삼: Chisam, Kim Cheomji's drinking friend, a Korean working man in his 40s in 1920s Seoul, round plump face, small eyes, thick black mustache, short hair under a worn dark felt fedora hat, sturdy stocky build, dark brown cotton jeogori with a grey vest and loose trousers, worn leather shoes
